notes: Body bounds come from original opaque raster pixels in all eight directions; attacks include extended hands/projectile origins and are not body-size targets.
Contact sheets use the actual Renderer.sprite path and current scale, downsampled to the measured mobile CSS scale. Platforms are included where active; no runtime files changed.
Roles calibrate a readable game hierarchy, not real-world Pokedex sizes or an asserted pixel-for-pixel Clash Royale screen measurement.
